fields.value: Corpora of Kelantan Malay, Coastal Terengganu Malay and Inland Terengganu Malay

dsDescriptionValue.value: The datasets include the corpora of three Malayic varieties spoken in the northeastern part of the Malay Peninsula, namely Kelantan Malay, Coastal Terengganu Malay and Inland Terengganu Malay. The corpora accompany the PhD dissertation titled 'Malayic varieties of Kelantan and Terengganu: Description and linguistic history'.

keywordValue.value: descriptive linguistics, historical linguistics, Malayic, Austronesian languages

publicationCitation.value: Wu, Jiang. 2023. Malayic varieties of Kelantan and Terengganu: Description and linguistic history. Amsterdam: LOT.
